coverage.summary: Applies to most residential rentals: single-family homes, mobile homes and mobile home park land, apartment buildings and complexes, and rooming and boarding homes. Owner-occupied two- and three-unit premises are outside the full good-cause protection and are subject only to a narrower set of removal grounds.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied (landlord-occupied) two- and three-family dwellings are excluded from the full good-cause list. Tenants there may be removed only on the narrower grounds of N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.2(a).
coverage.other_conditions: Hotel and motel guests are covered if they have no alternate residence and reside at the hotel or motel on a continual basis.
